# cloudsmith_entitlement_list (Data Source)

The `entitlement_tokens` data source allows for retrieval of a list of entitlement tokens within a given repository.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright Cloudsmith Ltd 2026
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

provider "cloudsmith" {
  api_key = "my-api-key"
}

data "cloudsmith_organization" "my_organization" {
  slug = "my-organization"
}

data "cloudsmith_repository" "my_repository" {
  namespace  = data.cloudsmith_organization.my_organization.slug_perm
  identifier = "my-repository"
}

data "cloudsmith_entitlement_list" "my_tokens" {
  namespace    = data.cloudsmith_repository.my_repository.namespace
  repository   = data.cloudsmith_repository.my_repository.id
  query        = ["name:Default"]
  show_token   = true
  active_token = true
}

output "tokens" {
  value = data.cloudsmith_entitlement_list.my_tokens.entitlement_tokens.*.token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `namespace` (String) The namespace slug.
- `repository` (String) The repository slug.

### Optional

- `active_token` (Boolean) If true, only include active tokens.
- `query` (Set of String) A search term for querying names of entitlements.
- `show_token` (Boolean) Show entitlement token strings in results.

### Read-Only

- `entitlement_tokens` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entitlement_tokens))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
